# An env-only fixture key creates and migrates a new AES-256-GCM database.
env MINA_DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=mina-integration-fixture-key
env MINA_FX_AUTO_LOAD_ENABLED=false
mkdir $WORK/home
env HOME=$WORK/home
exec mina migrate --db $WORK/encrypted-migrate.duckdb --yes
exec mina db validate --db $WORK/encrypted-migrate.duckdb
stdout 'ok: database is valid'
duckdbencryption $WORK/encrypted-migrate.duckdb
stdout 'encrypted=true cipher=GCM'

# Local clients create, reopen, mutate, and close encrypted state cleanly.
env MINA_BACKUP_FILE_DIRECTORY=$WORK/backups
exec mina client --db $WORK/encrypted.duckdb --yes tags create --json '{"fqn":"EncryptedCLI"}'
stdout '"fqn":"EncryptedCLI"'
exec mina client --db $WORK/encrypted.duckdb --yes tags list
stdout '"fqn":"EncryptedCLI"'
duckdbencryption $WORK/encrypted.duckdb
stdout 'encrypted=true cipher=GCM'
! exists $WORK/encrypted.duckdb.wal

# Long-running serve reopens the same encrypted file and shuts down cleanly.
freeport
exec mina serve --db $WORK/encrypted.duckdb --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &server&
httpwait -timeout 10s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health
kill -INT server
wait server
! exists $WORK/encrypted.duckdb.wal

# A missing key fails with DuckDB's native error.
! exec env -u MINA_DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY mina db validate --db $WORK/encrypted.duckdb
stderr 'Cannot open encrypted database'

# Encrypted primaries produce encrypted backups that validate and restore only with the key.
exec mina client --db $WORK/encrypted.duckdb --yes operations start-database-backup
stdout '"operation_id":"database-backup"'
stdout '"outcome":"succeeded"'
glob backups/mina-backup-*.duckdb
! glob backups/.*.tmp-*
glob backups/mina-backup-*.duckdb BACKUP
cp $BACKUP $WORK/restored.duckdb
duckdbencryption $WORK/restored.duckdb
stdout 'encrypted=true cipher=GCM'
! exec env -u MINA_DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY mina db validate --db $WORK/restored.duckdb
stderr 'Cannot open encrypted database'
exec mina db validate --db $WORK/restored.duckdb
stdout 'ok: database is valid'
exec mina client --db $WORK/restored.duckdb --yes tags list
stdout '"fqn":"EncryptedCLI"'
! exists $WORK/restored.duckdb.wal

# Backslashes are treated as key bytes rather than DuckDB BLOB escapes.
env 'MINA_DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=visible-secret\value'
exec mina migrate --db $WORK/backslash-key.duckdb --yes
! stderr 'visible-secret'
exec mina db validate --db $WORK/backslash-key.duckdb
stdout 'ok: database is valid'
! stderr 'visible-secret'
